content.short: Dollar-cost averaging that streams your USDC into tokens with no swap fees and pays you rewards.
content.description: Super DCA turns USDC into Super USDC and streams it into a chosen token at a monthly rate, so buying happens continuously instead of in lump sums. Instead of paying swap fees, users earn a 0.5% reward on every USDC spent, paid every two weeks, and Chainlink price feeds let anyone check the price impact of each trade. It runs as a Uniswap v4 hook and has received grants from Optimism and a Unichain retro grant from the Uniswap Foundation.
content.meta: Stream USDC into any token with Super DCA's Uniswap v4 hook, paying no swap fees and earning 0.5% back.
